scoring_justification: Barriers are recomputed from the submitted raw MP2 energies and compared to paper-reported gold values with tolerance; the ordering of barriers is also verified.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold activation barriers and isomer energy difference for the H- + SiH3F2- reaction at MP2/6-31++G** level, as reported in the paper's Table I and Table V.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I, row b (MP2/6-31++G**//RHF/6-31++G**) and Table V, row b (total energies).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the published paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are taken verbatim from the paper and are confirmed consistent with the reference solve.sh that writes the same numbers.

outputs.description: MP2/6-31++G** single-point energies of reactants and transition states for H⁻ attack on SiH₃F₂⁻, together with the activation barriers and isomer energy difference.

steps.note: Check barrier ordering TS2 < TS3 < TS1
